work.title: The Magic School Bus Rides Again
work.note: The Magic School Bus Rides Again é uma nova versão da série animada, lançada em 2017 pela Netflix em parceria com a Scholastic. A cena cultural serve de ponte para o foco “falar do ônibus: catch the bus (pegar o ônibus a tempo) e miss the bus (perder o ônibus)”. A referência mostra um ônibus escolar: catch the bus, miss the bus.

pages.title: A movie night · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday night in a cozy living room in Austin. Bia and Eli sit on the sofa with a blanket. The TV is on but the screen is blank. They have many movies to choose from. Neither of them wants to decide alone. Bia takes the remote control and smiles.
“What should we watch tonight?” says Bia. “How about a comedy? I want to laugh.” says Eli. “Hmm, I’d like something different.” says Bia.
